purpose: A-A early-time law at large r (round 3): r0 = 5.0, H, at rest, centre (5,5), T = 1.0, sample_dt 0.0025. Tests whether the P-0024 relative acceleration (G = 23.63, P = 2.099) holds at r0 = 4-6 over t <= 1, where runs 2026-11-23/r1/lab-keystone/001-006 (T = 2) show residuals of 0.13-0.19 against noise near 0.07. Pre-registered: P-0024 at noise for t <= 1; a P = 2.5 law fitted at r = 1-3 predicts about 20 percent less pull at r = 5.
